data.body: [P2] This traversal assumes an acyclic, well-behaved cause chain. A custom `CompletionException`/`ExecutionException` can form a cause cycle or override `getCause()`, making every plugin failure boundary loop forever or replace the original failure with an accessor exception. That violates containment of nonfatal plugin failures and can time out the invocation. Traverse with an identity-based visited set, read each cause once under the same fatal-error policy, and make `normalizeInvocationFailure` use the same cycle-safe logic. Cover cyclic asynchronous wrappers in tests.
